label: Hikvision DS-7608NI-K2
description: Hikvision DS-7608NI-K2 is the plain 8-channel 4K NVR of the K2 Pro series: two SATA bays for up to 10 TB each, 80 Mbps incoming bandwidth and H.265+ decoding, with no built-in PoE switch, so every camera needs its own injector or PoE switch port. Its single network interface is one RJ45 10/100/1000 Mbps self-adaptive Ethernet port, and there is no wireless radio.
notes: From the Hikvision datasheet: Network '1, RJ-45 10/100/1000 Mbps self-adaptive Ethernet interface'; 2 SATA interfaces, up to 10 TB per HDD; up to 80 Mbps incoming bandwidth; alarm in/out 4/1; 12 VDC 3.33 A, 15 W without HDD; 1 HDMI + 1 VGA. This is deliberately the non-PoE sibling of the catalogue's DS-7608NI-K2/8P - same recorder, one NIC, no 8-port switch - so the two models answer different lab questions: the /8P creates the hidden 192.168.254.0/24 camera subnet, this one puts the cameras straight on the office LAN. Not confirmed: Hikvision does not publish a maximum draw with both bays populated, so 15 W is the diskless figure. No dhcp-server or l2-forward is claimed, because with a single NIC there is nothing to bridge or serve.
